module.purpose: Provides lossless conversions, validation, filtering, planning, and snapshot rehydration for comment-related room records persisted in Postgres and synchronized through the comment outbox.
module.summary: This module is the persistence boundary for comment threads, comments, reactions, and mentions. It converts between tldraw records and database rows, validates records rebuilt from potentially corrupt storage, reconstructs room snapshot documents, filters soft-deleted data, preserves clock floors, and plans idempotent outbox writes and cleanup. It also classifies PostgreSQL foreign-key failures so callers can distinguish permanently prunable records from transient failures.
module.businessContext: Supports collaborative document comments, mentions, reactions, and thread lifecycle persistence. Failures can prevent room recovery, leave stale outbox entries, or expose invalid comment data.
